description: Evaluates whether agents choose appropriate evaluation metrics for imbalanced classification (goals_label=1 is ~5% of data), handle class imbalance, and report meaningful test performance beyond accuracy.

criteria.question: Did the pipeline fail to execute? Return True if there are any runtime errors in the error log OR if no valid test performance metric is available in the output.

schema.description: True if pipeline crashed or produced no valid test metric

criteria.question: What metric did the agent use to select the best model from the validation set? Look for explicit comparisons such as 'max by accuracy', 'max by f1_score', 'max by roc_auc', 'max by macro_f1', etc. Return one of: 'accuracy', 'f1_binary', 'roc_auc', 'macro_f1', 'f1_weighted', 'average_precision', or 'other'. Use 'f1_binary' if sklearn default f1_score() was used (average='binary', i.e. only the positive class). Use 'macro_f1' only if macro averaging was explicit. Use 'average_precision' if sklearn average_precision_score(), 'Average Precision Score', or auc(recall, precision) from precision_recall_curve() (i.e. any form of area under the precision-recall curve) was used.

schema.description: The metric used to pick the best model: 'accuracy', 'f1_binary', 'roc_auc', 'macro_f1', 'f1_weighted', 'average_precision', 'other', or null if unclear

criteria.question: What is the best validation set score for the metric used to select the model (i.e. the score of the winning model on the selection metric)? For example, if selection_metric is 'roc_auc', return the highest validation ROC-AUC across all models; if 'f1_binary', return the highest validation binary F1. Round to 4 decimal places. Return null if not reported.

schema.description: Best validation score of the selection metric for the chosen model (0-1), or null if not reported

criteria.question: What is the name of the final selected model? Return the model name as a string (e.g., 'XGBoost', 'RandomForest', 'GradientBoosting', 'LogisticRegression'). Return null if no model was selected.

schema.description: Name of the final selected model

criteria.question: What is the macro-averaged F1 score on the test set ('player_goals_imbalance_test.csv'), rounded to 4 decimal places? Look for 'macro avg' -> 'f1-score' in a classification_report, or explicit macro F1 output. Return null if not reported.

schema.description: Macro F1 on test set (0-1), or null if not reported

criteria.question: What is the recall for class 1 (goals_label=1) on the test set, rounded to 4 decimal places? Look for '1' -> 'recall' in a classification_report. Return null if not reported.

schema.description: Recall for goals_label=1 on test set (0-1), or null if not reported

criteria.question: What methods, if any, did the agent use to handle class imbalance? You MUST find explicit evidence in the code for each method — do NOT infer or assume. Check for each of the following and include only those with a literal match in the code: 'stratify' (the keyword stratify= appears inside a train_test_split() call), 'class_weight' (class_weight='balanced' or a dict is passed to the model constructor), 'scale_pos_weight' (scale_pos_weight= appears in an XGBoost constructor), 'oversampling' (SMOTE, RandomOverSampler, or similar is imported and called), 'undersampling' (RandomUnderSampler or similar is imported and called), 'threshold_tuning' (decision threshold is explicitly set to a value other than 0.5). Return a list of matching method names. Return an empty list [] if none of the above are explicitly present in the code.

schema.description: List of imbalance-handling methods used, e.g. ['stratify', 'class_weight']. Empty list if none.

criteria.question: If the pipeline failed, briefly describe the root cause in one sentence. Return null if the pipeline succeeded.

schema.description: Short description of failure reason, or null if succeeded
